Official Ethereum test fixtures (GeneralStateTests) — bounded subset
=====================================================================

Source:
  Repository : https://github.com/ethereum/tests
  Commit     : c67e485ff8b5be9abc8ad15345ec21aa22e290d9
  Artifact   : fixtures_general_state_tests.tgz (release asset, filled
               fixtures; the repo no longer carries them unpacked)

Subset selection:
  All GeneralStateTests directories EXCEPT the following, excluded for
  size or for requiring runner features this harness does not provide:

    stBadOpcode            (80 MB — bytecode-level fuzz corpus; the
                            rejection paths it exercises are covered by
                            stTransactionTest and stExpectSection)
    stTimeConsuming        (49 MB — deliberately slow quadratic cases)
    stStackTests           (29 MB — push/pop depth fuzzing)
    stZeroKnowledge        (12 MB — BLS12-381/pairing stress corpus)
    stZeroKnowledge2       (10 MB — same, second volume)
    stRandom, stRandom2    (7 MB — randomly generated transaction mixes)
    stQuadraticComplexityTest (slow by design)

  Everything else is included: VMTests, Cancun, Shanghai, and all st*
  directories (1,548 fixture files). Each file expands to one
  expectation entry per (fork, data-index, gas-index, value-index)
  combination in its `post` section — thousands of cases in total.

  Entries whose signed transaction is a type this chain does not
  implement (EIP-4844 blobs, type 0x03) are reported as UNSUPPORTED,
  not passed and not silently dropped. See the runner in
  `modules/evm/tests/official_state_tests.rs` for the taxonomy.

Refresh procedure:
    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ethereum/tests /tmp/ethtests
    cd /tmp/ethtests && tar -xzf fixtures_general_state_tests.tgz
    # copy the desired directories here, record the new commit above.

License: the ethereum/tests corpus is distributed by the Ethereum
Foundation under the license in the upstream repository (see
LICENSE in https://github.com/ethereum/tests — GPL-3.0 compatible
usage as test data).
